sloka: ब्रह्मण्यश्च शरण्यश्च बुद्ध्या च परिनिष्ठितः ।सुरैश्च परमोदारैः प्रीतिस्तस्यातुला ऽभवत् ।। ७.६१.४ ॥
transliteration: brahmaṇyaśca śaraṇyaśca buddhyā ca pariniṣṭhitaḥ ।suraiśca paramodāraiḥ prītistasyātulā 'bhavat ।। 7.61.4 ॥

translations.english: He was devoted to Brahmins, a protector, and firmly resolved in his wisdom, and he had an unequalled affection for the exceedingly generous gods.
